description_en: Queries the details of lightweight database instances
description_zh: 查看轻量数据库实例信息
name: DescribeDatabaseInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the lightweight database instances. The value can be a JSON array that consists of multiple instance IDs. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
轻量数据库实例ID。
取值可以由多个轻量数据库实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个实例ID，ID之间用英文半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: database_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the lightweight database instance list.

Starting value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
轻量数据库实例列表的页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

DatabaseInstances.description_en: The details of the lightweight database instances
DatabaseInstances.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例集合信息

items.description_en: The details of the lightweight database instances
items.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例集合信息

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the instance. Valid values:

normal: Normal.
expired: Expired.
overdue: Overdue payment
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
业务状态。可能值：

normal: 正常。
expired: 到期。
overdue: 欠费

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the lightweight database instance. Only the subscription billing method is supported. Set the value to PrePaid.

Default value: PrePaid
ChargeType.description_zh:
轻量数据库例的计费方式。目前只支持包年包月的计费方式，取值为PrePaid。

默认值：PrePaid

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC+0
CreationTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DatabaseInstanceEdition.description_en:
The plan ID of the lightweight database instance. Valid values:

swas.db.c1m1s25: CNY 35 per month.

swas.db.c1m2s80: CNY 100 per month.

swas.db.c2m4s120: CNY 200 per month.
swas.db.c2m8s240: CNY 300 per month
DatabaseInstanceEdition.description_zh:
轻量数据库实例套餐版本ID。可能值：

swas.db.c1m1s25：35元/月。

swas.db.c1m2s80：100元/月。

swas.db.c2m4s120：200元/月。
swas.db.c2m8s240：300元/月

DatabaseInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the lightweight database

DatabaseInstanceName.description_en: The name of the lightweight database instance

DatabaseInstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the lightweight database instance. Valid values:

Pending: The instance is being created.
Restarting: The instance is being restarted.
Running: The instance is running.
Stopping: The instance is being stopped.
Stopped: The instance is stopped.
UPGRADING: The instance is being upgraded.
DISABLED: The instance is disabled
DatabaseInstanceStatus.description_zh:
轻量数据库服务实例状态：可能值

Pending: 创建中。
Restarting：重启中。
Running：运行中。
Stopping：停止中。
Stopped：已停止。
UPGRADING：升级中。
DISABLED：已禁用

DatabaseVersion.description_en:
The database version. Valid values:

5.7: MySQL 5.7.
8.0: MySQL 8.0

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The time when the instance expires. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and is displayed in UTC+0.

The expiration time displayed in the console is 8 hours ahead of the UTC time
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
实例到期时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间

PublicConnection.description_en:
The public endpoint.

This parameter is returned only if a public endpoint is applied for. You can call the [AllocatePublicConnection]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451413.html） operation to apply for a public endpoint
PublicConnection.description_zh:
公网链接地址。

只有申请开通公网访问地址才显示此参数。您可以调用[AllocatePublicConnection]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451413.html）申请外网地址

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance
RegionId.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID

Storage.description_en: The capacity of the ESSD cloud disk. Unit: GB

SuperAccountName.description_en: The name of the privileged account of the lightweight database instance
SuperAccountName.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例超级账号名称

PageNumber.description_en: The page number for a paged query
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in the lightweight database instance list
PageSize.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例列表的当前页码
